description: Cross-check PRM5 interactions in IntAct and tabulate the full SGD curation record (GO, phenotype, interaction) by evidence throughput
code:
import requests, json, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. IntAct (PSICQUIC/ EBI proxy)
intact_rows=[]
try:
    u="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/intact/ws/interaction/findInteractions"
    r=requests.get(u, params={"query":"P40476","page":0,"pageSize":100}, timeout=90)
    print("IntAct HTTP", r.status_code)
    if r.status_code==200:
        j=r.json(); content=j.get("content",[])
        print("IntAct interaction records for P40476:", j.get("totalElements"))
        for c in content:
            intact_rows.append(dict(a=c.get("moleculeA"), b=c.get("moleculeB"),
                                    typeA=c.get("typeA"), typeB=c.get("typeB"),
                                    detection=c.get("detectionMethod"), type=c.get("type"),
                                    expansion=c.get("expansion"), pubid=c.get("publicationIdentifier")))
        for row in intact_rows[:30]: print("   ", row)
        if not content: print("   -> IntAct returns ZERO curated interaction records for P40476")
except Exception as e:
    print("IntAct query failed:", type(e).__name__, e)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 2. SGD tables -> provenance CSV
S="https://www.yeastgenome.org/backend/locus/S000001379"
go=requests.get(S+"/go_details",timeout=120).json()
ph=requests.get(S+"/phenotype_details",timeout=120).json()
it=requests.get(S+"/interaction_details",timeout=120).json()

go_df=pd.DataFrame([dict(record="GO", go_id=g['go']['go_id'], term=g['go']['display_name'],
                         aspect=g['go']['go_aspect'], annotation_type=g.get('annotation_type'),
                         qualifier=g.get('qualifier'), source=(g.get('source') or {}).get('display_name'))
                    for g in go]).drop_duplicates()
ph_df=pd.DataFrame([dict(record="PHENOTYPE",
                         phenotype=(p.get('phenotype') or {}).get('display_name'),
                         mutant_type=p.get('mutant_type'),
                         experiment=(p.get('experiment') or {}).get('display_name'),
                         annotation_type=p.get('experiment_type') or p.get('annotation_type'),
                         pmid=(p.get('reference') or {}).get('pubmed_id'))
                    for p in ph])
def partner(i):
    a=i.get('locus1',{}).get('display_name'); b=i.get('locus2',{}).get('display_name')
    return b if a=='PRM5' else a
it_df=pd.DataFrame([dict(record="INTERACTION", partner=partner(i), interaction_type=i.get('interaction_type'),
                         annotation_type=i.get('annotation_type'),
                         pmid=(i.get('reference') or {}).get('pubmed_id')) for i in it])

sgd=pd.concat([go_df,ph_df,it_df],ignore_index=True)
sgd.to_csv("PRM5_SGD_curation_record.csv",index=False)
print("\nwrote PRM5_SGD_curation_record.csv rows =", len(sgd))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3. headline counts
print("\n--- GO by aspect/annotation_type ---")
print(go_df.groupby(['aspect','annotation_type']).size())
print("\nROOT-term (unknown) annotations manually curated by SGD:",
      sorted(go_df[go_df.go_id.isin(['GO:0003674','GO:0008150'])].term.tolist()))
print("\n--- phenotype annotation_type ---"); print(ph_df.annotation_type.value_counts(dropna=False))
print("--- phenotype mutant_type ---"); print(ph_df.mutant_type.value_counts(dropna=False))
print("\n--- interactions ---")
print(it_df.groupby(['interaction_type','annotation_type']).size())
mrna={'HEK2','NAB2','PUF2','DHH1','CCR4'}
ph_part=set(it_df[it_df.interaction_type=='Physical'].partner)
print("\nphysical partners that are mRNA-binding / decay factors:", sorted(ph_part & mrna),
      f"= {len(ph_part & mrna)}/{len(ph_part)}")
print("physical partners that are the PF28230 paralogs (YNL058C, CSI2):",
      sorted(ph_part & {'YNL058C','CSI2'}) or "NONE")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 4. figure
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(14,4.2))
g=go_df.groupby(['aspect','annotation_type']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
g.plot(kind='barh',stacked=True,ax=ax[0],color=['#b0b0b0','#2b6cb0'])
ax[0].set_title("SGD GO record: MF and BP are root terms,\nonly CC is populated and only computationally",fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_xlabel("annotations"); ax[0].set_ylabel("")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=7)

n_ht=(ph_df.annotation_type=='high-throughput').sum(); n_other=len(ph_df)-n_ht
ax[1].bar(['high-throughput','low-throughput'],[n_ht,n_other],color=['#dd6b20','#2f855a'])
ax[1].set_title(f"18 phenotype records for prm5$\\Delta$:\nall from systematic screens",fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_ylabel("phenotype annotations")
for i,v in enumerate([n_ht,n_other]): ax[1].text(i,v+0.3,str(v),ha='center',fontsize=9)

cnt=it_df.groupby(['interaction_type','annotation_type']).size()
labs=[f"{a}\n{b}" for a,b in cnt.index]
ax[2].bar(labs,cnt.values,color=['#805ad5','#3182ce'])
ax[2].set_title("40 interactions, none low-throughput;\n5/9 physical partners are mRNA-binding proteins",fontsize=9)
ax[2].set_ylabel("interaction records")
for i,v in enumerate(cnt.values): ax[2].text(i,v+0.4,str(v),ha='center',fontsize=9)
plt.suptitle("PRM5 / YIL117C (P40476): the SGD curation record carries no direct functional evidence",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
